name: Asougi Kazuma
source:
A second year at the Imperial Yumei University. He's my best friend and, despite being a student, a qualified defence lawyer as well.
[spoiler]He was on his way to London for a study tour when he was taken from this world.

([url=/v19987]Dai Gyakuten Saiban 2 -Naruhodou Ryuunosuke no Kakugo-[/url])
My best friend, who I had believed to be dead. He lost his memory somehow, but has now materialised as a prosecutor in the British courts.[/spoiler]
